notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content: [p]Thank you very much to everyone who played and left their comments![/p][p]After them, I decided to make a few changes:[/p][p][/p][p]- On the 5th week, a saw appeared under the bed, so that u wouldn't have to run every time.[/p][p]- The Bush-Neighbor now works according to unique rules and has its own cutscene, and in general should be activated less often.[/p][p]- Improved object physics, now knives will get stuck less often[/p][p]- Tutorial in the utility room is no longer confusing[/p][p]- Tutorial in the basement is now a little more obvious[/p][p]- Added the Child Play achievement, it was really asking for it.[/p][p]- Added 4 new languages.[/p][p]- Police officers began to see noticeably worse.[/p][p]- And even more small changes designed to simplify the game...[/p][p][/p][p]The following bug fixes were also made:[/p][p]- You can no longer get out of the basement if you locked yourself in, accept death![/p][p]- Fixed the tree that everyone was tripping over[/p][p]- Weekly achievement, now correctly awarded on the third[/p][p]- You can now get objects out of the barrel if you dropped them there[/p][p]- The Morbid Engineering and You're doing it wrong achievements can now be correctly obtained.[/p][p][/p][p]P.S. I hope I managed to reduce the difficulty without depriving the game of a challenge. I will wait for your amazing comments ^_^[/p]
